page.overview:
Who is Farmworld Peanut?

Peanut is the only son of Big Destiny, the younger brother of Little Destiny, and a member of the Destiny Gang.

As of "The Lion of Embers", he has been shown to kill his father Big Destiny via a trained wolf.

Peanut is a young boy with light brown skin, brown hair, and a black helmet that covers most of his hair apart from one tuft. His helmet has a grey spike on the top, white circles on the left and right sides with a yellow star inside each one, and a chin strap akin to that of a bike helmet.

His outfit consists of a pink scarf, a light shirt with a brown jacket on-top, a singular shoulder pad on his left shoulder, dark pink shorts, a single knee pad on his right knee, and light brown boots.
